Model.reasoning: The header names the biological property or trait being modeled (e.g., 'Body size CWM').

$\\Delta$ AICc.reasoning: This column holds the numerical result of the statistical model fit (change in AICc).

K.reasoning: This column holds the numerical value representing the number of parameters in the model.

$\\omega_{i}$.reasoning: This column holds the numerical value of a specific model coefficient or parameter.

$R^{2}$.reasoning: This column holds the numerical value of the coefficient of determination (goodness of fit).
